features: Free in-browser view of what a PDF's tags give a screen reader. Each page gets numbered pins in the file's order beside a list: headings, pictures with or without a description, tables, untagged text, and visible words marked as decoration, which screen readers that follow the tags skip. The file stays in the tab. No score or conformance claim.
title: What your PDF's tags give a screen reader
